body:
Conversational voice and devices for the approved anonymous NES multiplayer release. This is a bounded outcome under epic #2, not authorization to skip its dependencies.

## Requirements

- Parent epic: #2; stable plan ID: `D17`.
- Priority: **P1: conversation**. Priority orders eligible work only.
- Source: [approved plan snapshot](https://github.com/TuringTestee/retro-coop/blob/ecf6bd4c7443526f0a163b721a351c854ee90fd4/docs/implementation/browser-nes-audit.md), row D17; design social; UI U7.
- Governing [design](https://github.com/TuringTestee/retro-coop/blob/ecf6bd4c7443526f0a163b721a351c854ee90fd4/docs/design/browser-nes-platform.md), [UI](https://github.com/TuringTestee/retro-coop/blob/ecf6bd4c7443526f0a163b721a351c854ee90fd4/docs/design/browser-nes-ui.md), and [architecture/delivery](https://github.com/TuringTestee/retro-coop/blob/ecf6bd4c7443526f0a163b721a351c854ee90fd4/docs/implementation/browser-nes-platform.md).
- User approved reviewed head `2e8adfcd3259f5bdffdc9a13ef9b983f78cfb965` and explicitly requested merge/start; [planning PR #3](https://github.com/TuringTestee/retro-coop/pull/3) merged as `ecf6bd4c7443526f0a163b721a351c854ee90fd4`.

## Observable acceptance

Two-way open mic, optional push-to-talk, permission/device failures, local/remote mute, blur/leave stop and retry without gameplay reset. AC-08/16 functional; S21/S34.

## Dependencies and ownership

- Blocks on: [D10 #14](https://github.com/TuringTestee/retro-coop/issues/14), [D07 #11](https://github.com/TuringTestee/retro-coop/issues/11).
- Original dependency scope: D10, D07.
- Status: In progress; functional voice implemented on feat/d17-voice. Current source 041fb5d adds explicit open mic/push-to-talk, mute/device/retry controls and peer teardown. Actual short Chrome/Firefox direct and local-relay tests have passed; final expanded rejoin regression, current evidence and independent PR acceptance are in preparation. Peer investigation is tracked separately in #53 / PR #54. Public-network, real-speaker and 30-minute concurrent gameplay qualification remain #25/#27 gates.
- Builder: /root. Work branch: feat/d17-voice; owned worktree: /tmp/retro-d17-voice. Dispatcher and sole merge owner: root orchestrator.
- Delivery board: https://github.com/orgs/TuringTestee/projects/1 . Issues own acceptance, dependencies and ownership; the board reflects them.

## Boundaries and delivery

No new accounts, user-ROM sharing/storage, server gameplay, streaming fallback, recording, or unapproved scope. Reuse approved architecture and existing assets; leave bounded implementation details to the builder. Source plans hold rationale; this issue owns live acceptance, blockers and ownership.

Use issue-resolver in an isolated worktree, focused tests and README preflight, bounded CI, and independent local review. Follow epic #2’s explicit policy B authorization: the implementation agent may merge after current-head local review acceptance and passing required checks, respecting branch protections. Do not request per-PR approval again; verify integration before releasing dependent work. Completion requires acceptance/integration evidence, not merely an issue closure. Link implementation PRs to this child issue without closing epic #2.
title: Feature: D17 Conversational voice and devices
